name: impeccable
title_zh: 会先问「给谁用」再动手的界面打磨师
tagline_zh: 改稿前先做 UX 审计，不急着换色。从落地页到空状态都管，专治「看着还行但说不清哪不对」的界面。
tagline_en: UX review first, color swap later. Covers landing pages to empty states — for UIs that feel off but you can't say.
desc_en: Use when the user wants to design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, clarify, distill, harden, optimize, adapt, animate, colorize, extract, or otherwise improve a frontend interface. Covers websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, settings, onboarding, and empty states. Handles UX review, visual hierarchy, information architecture, cognitive load, acc
why_zh: 先诊断后动刀：它按认知负荷、视觉层级、信息架构逐层过，而不是上来就改像素。
why_en: Diagnoses before it operates: walks cognitive load, hierarchy, IA layer by layer instead of pixel-pushing on sight.
limit_zh: 只处理前端界面，不碰后端逻辑与数据库。产出是修改建议与方案，不直接改代码文件。
limit_en: Frontend UI only; no backend or DB. Outputs recommendations, not code edits.
title_en: A frontend polisher that audits before it touches a pixel
